The intention of this endpoint is to credit claims in Receive.
Notes:
  - Crediting the claim will decrease the amount of the claim.
  - If the claim amount is zero, the claim will be resolved.
  - When you provide fees as a number, it will reduce totalFees of the claim
  - When you provide fees as an array, we check
    - if a fee with same name already exists for the claim, if so, we substract incoming fee amount from existing fee amount and subtract fee.amount from totalFees of the claim
    - if a fee with same name does not exist, we ignore it
  - if you want to credit to fees only, set amount to 0.
  - if you want to credit to fees first, and then remaining amount to claim amount, do not send `fees` field (send `amount` only)
For more details about the Claim, and the relationship with the other entities please visit the [Account](https://docs.indebted.co/docs/receive/integration/account-claims) page.

The intention of this endpoint is to debit claims in Receive.
Notes:
  - Debiting the claim will increase the amount and/or totalFees of the claim.
  - When you provide fees as a number, it will be added to the totalFees of the claim
  - When you provide fees as an array, we check
    - if a fee with same name already exists for the claim, if so, we add incoming fee amount to existing fee amount and add fee.amount to totalFees of the claim
    - if a fee with same name does not exist, we create a new fee with the provided name and add fee.amount to totalFees of the claim
  - if you want to debit to fees only, set amount to 0.
For more details about the Claim, and the relationship with the other entities please visit the [Account](https://docs.indebted.co/docs/receive/integration/account-claims) page.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Links claims into a shared-liability group or breaks existing links.

**What linking does:** Claims in the same link group become synced mirrors of the same underlying debt. Whenever any claim in the group is updated, the platform overwrites the `amount`, `totalFees`, and `fees` fields on every other claim in the group via `cmd.linkedClaims.sync`. This means all linked claims always reflect the same balance.

**Intended use case — shared liability only:** Use linking when multiple accounts (e.g. co-debtors or guarantors) each hold a separate claim representing the same debt. Linking keeps their balances in sync automatically.

**Do NOT use for instalments or independent claims:** Linking instalments of a single purchase, or any set of claims with different individual balances, will cause every claim's amount to overwrite the others', corrupting all balances in the group.

Notes:
  - Provide a mapping of external claim references to other claim references to link them
  - Use null as the value to unlink a claim

For more details about the Claim, and the relationship with the other entities please visit the [Account](https://docs.indebted.co/docs/receive/integration/account-claims) page.
